items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Terminology 91:1
items.html: (To the question) What is the Nukva at the height of her diminishment? The height of the diminishment of the Nukva is the aspect of the point under the Yesod of ZA, from the aspect of the lights, and the point under the chest of ZA, from the aspect of the vessels. For this point is the Malchut of the vessels of the face of the Nekudim, and after they were corrected in Atzilut, no diminishment prevails in them any more. See above, Answer 11. (Item 5 and 6).
